about: Water names in Missouri's records that data/receiving-waters-national.json does not hold for MO: every water KC Water's and MSD's overflow posts and DNR's concern reports name, the waters DNR's bloom map shows a bloom on, and the receiving stream of each combined sewer outfall on DNR's outfall layer; one row per name and county (the county of the record's point, else the county a concern gives, else the counties of the operator's area), with the number of reports, the outfall count and points of the outfalls, and the operator, so the names pass builds each name where the reports are. Records naming no water are left out (by_reason). Written by scripts/mo_report_water_names.py.
